introHtml: Koozie no touch door opener tools combine the trusted quality of Koozie's manufacturing with practical hygiene solutions. These door hangers and knob bags let you open doors without direct hand contact, making them ideal for safety-conscious businesses, schools, and healthcare facilities. Customize them with your logo or message using screen printing or full-color imprinting. Choose from durable paper or plastic materials to suit your needs.
